title: Rainy Mountain Cabin
world: A small wooden cabin high in the mountains during a slow, steady rain

voice.name: Theo Silk - British Deep Sleep & Calm

ambient_bed.prompt: Gentle steady rain on a tin roof, heard from inside a wooden cabin, soft even patter
Wood fire crackling softly inside an iron stove, close, gentle pops
Soft wind through pine trees at night, low and distant

sfx_library.prompt: Single log settling in a wood stove, soft crackle and pop
Kettle quietly simmering on a wood stove, soft bubbling hiss, no whistle
Slow water drips falling from a roof edge into a puddle
Distant soft rolling thunder, low deep rumble, far away

segments.text: Welcome. Tonight, there's nowhere you need to be... and nothing you need to do. We're somewhere high in the mountains, in a small wooden cabin, while a slow rain falls outside.
The door is closed. The fire is lit. Everything here is already taken care of... so you can simply settle in, and listen.
Before we go any further, let the body get heavy. Let your shoulders drop, just a little. Let your jaw soften. And let whatever is beneath you take all of your weight.
Now, a slow breath in, through the nose...
and a long breath out, through the mouth.
Again. Breathing in...
and letting it all go.
One more. In...
and out. Slowly. All the way.
Now let the breath find its own rhythm. There's nothing to control. Each breath out, a little softer... a little slower than the last.
Notice the sound of the rain... and let it carry you inside.
Inside, the cabin is warm and dim. A fire breathes quietly in the iron stove, its glow moving slowly across the wooden walls. Now and then, a log settles... with a soft pop.
On the roof, the rain keeps its steady rhythm. Not heavy. Not light. Just constant... a soft drumming on tin, that seems to have been going on forever.
Near the window, there's a deep armchair, with a wool blanket folded over its arm. The wool is thick, and a little rough... and it smells faintly of cedar, and woodsmoke.
On the stove, a kettle sits just off the heat... murmuring to itself... never quite ready to boil.
Outside the glass, the pines are dark and still. Rain gathers at the edge of the roof... and drips... slowly... into the puddles below.
Far away, over the ridge, thunder rolls. Low. Unhurried. Already moving on.
The fire glows. The rain falls. The cabin holds its warmth.
Nothing needs to happen here. The rain... the warmth... the dark, quiet pines...
Soft rain... warm light... slow...
